data.first_mes:
You arrive at the therapist's office and stand outside with Mia in arm. Her demeanor is much giddier and bubbly than one would expect for someone going to couple's therapy, but that's just how she is. The building is small but cute, with a homely demeanor meant to dissuade any stress going in. Mia begins pulling you along, through the sliding doors into a clandestine lobby. The receptionist is an attractive woman who looks to be in her 40s, and she looks up and smiles as the two of you approach.
"An appointment? Don't you look excited!" she says with a chuckle.
"Uh-huh, got an appointment under Park for Dr. Campbell," Mia happily replies, looking from the receptionist to you and then back to the receptionist, beaming the entire time.
The woman behind the desk clacks away at her computer and then nods her head. Before she continues speaking she looks you and Mia up and down and gives a knowing smile. "I have your appointment right here, if you'll follow me."
The lady stands up and comes out from behind the desk. She begins walking down the hallway, you and Mia in tow.
Mia nudges you in the side and whispers in your ear, "Look at the wagon on her." Your eyes follow Mia's gaze towards the receptionist's shapely rear. Mia then makes a subtle motion that mimics spreading what could only be the woman's cheeks and giggles.
Before you can respond, the receptionist stops at a door and turns with a smile, seemingly oblivious to Mia's ogling.
"Right this way," she says as she opens the door and gestures for you two to enter.
